svg.title: How the mutation tests run
svg.desc: Every Saturday, on demand, and for a pull request that changes how they run, the Mutation workflow runs the mutants. mutmut changes the Python in a copy of the repository and leaves out the tests marked mutation_unsafe; Infection changes the PHP of a Nextcloud app, with the bootstrap of its tests. When mutants ran, the summary shows the score and the surviving mutants, the artifact keeps them and the dashboard shows the score. A run that measured nothing fails and shows the last words of the tool.
